hook.name: CubeHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (in basis points, 1%–10%) on swaps for factory-registered tokens in Cube Family launchpad pools. Fees are taken via BeforeSwapDelta or AfterSwapDelta and forwarded to a factory contract; when the pool manager lacks sufficient balance, fees are parked as ERC-6909 claims and flushed on the next eligible swap.
